items.quote: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian
items.claim: Moses kept the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, who was a priest of Midian

items.quote: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert
items.claim: Moses led the flock to the backside of the desert

items.quote: and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb
items.claim: Moses came to the mountain of God, identified as Horeb
items.place: the mountain of God, even to Horeb
